nodes.label: executable.Main
nodes.desc: The java -jar jenkins.war entry point; extracts winstone.jar and delegates to Winstone's Launcher.

nodes.label: Jenkins
nodes.desc: The root singleton extending AbstractCIBase; owns items, the queue, plugin manager and extension lists.

nodes.label: Item
nodes.desc: Base interface for every configurable, persistable item living under the controller.

nodes.label: AbstractProject
nodes.desc: Abstract BuildableItem with scheduleBuild2, quiet period and disable logic.

nodes.label: FreeStyleProject
nodes.desc: The classic concrete project type, registered via @Extension(ordinal = 1000).

nodes.label: Queue
nodes.desc: Global build queue: waiting, blocked and buildable items plus a maintain() loop.

nodes.label: Executor
nodes.desc: A Thread per executor slot; pulls a WorkUnit from the queue and runs its Executable.

nodes.label: Computer
nodes.desc: Runtime state of one node (controller or agent) that owns a list of Executors.

nodes.label: ExtensionPoint
nodes.desc: Marker interface; every pluggable seam in Jenkins extends some ExtensionPoint subtype.

nodes.label: ExtensionList
nodes.desc: A lazily-loaded, live-updating list of all instances of one ExtensionPoint type.

nodes.label: CLICommand
nodes.desc: Abstract command class implementing ExtensionPoint; each command is a discoverable extension.

nodes.label: CLI client
nodes.desc: Client-side CLI that opens a FullDuplexHttpStream to the controller.

edges.label: pops a WorkUnit when a slot frees
nodes attach to the controller singleton
runs commands over a duplex stream
maintainer thread owned by the controller
